name: Greece
description: Greece from Minoan Crete and Mycenae to classical Athens, Alexander, Rome, Byzantium, Ottoman rule, independence and the modern republic.

checkpoints.name: Bronze Age
checkpoints.note: The Minoans built palaces on Crete, and the Mycenaean kings ruled the mainland.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Greece
checkpoints.note: City states rose. The Olympics began, Athens beat Persia and built the Parthenon, the philosophers taught, and Alexander conquered to India.

checkpoints.name: Rome and Byzantium
checkpoints.note: Greece became part of Rome. The eastern empire, ruled from Constantinople, was Greek in speech and faith.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman Greece
checkpoints.note: Greece was ruled by the Ottomans for nearly four centuries.

checkpoints.name: Modern Greece
checkpoints.note: The war of 1821 won independence. Athens hosted the first modern Olympics in 1896, Greece survived war and dictatorship, and joined Europe in 1981.
